description: This file contains Python code implementing sandboxed filesystem mutation operations such as write, mkdirp, remove, and rename, with functions for directory handling, temporary file creation, and command execution.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Opens a directory with specified flags.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Traverses directory segments, optionally creating directories.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in the specified directory.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Generates a filesystem path from a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with specified file descriptors.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Reads from stdin and writes to a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation in the sandboxed filesystem.

methods.name: run_mkdirp
methods.description: Creates directories recursively in the sandboxed filesystem.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Removes files or directories in the sandboxed filesystem.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Renames/moves files within the sandboxed filesystem.
